subject: MedSync Health — trial scope & environment decision
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@medsynchealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MedSync Health — trial scope & environment decision

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and an ops-forward proposal so we can unblock trial setup: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: validate secure clinical-summary extraction and embeddings for search + rerank at sub-200ms p50 generation for patient-facing flows.
- Data types: clinical notes, de-identified PDFs, and a small PHI subset (consent-managed).
- Success signal: 90% precision on extraction slices + end-to-end latency <= 200ms p50 in hosted eval, and tolerable cost per 1k queries.

Proposed evaluation plan (high level)
1) Week 0: exchange minimal network info + test keys; Redwoods spins a small hosted trial with a representative model and dataset subset.
2) Week 1–2: run inference tests (latency/cost/quality) using the supplied eval set; run embedding/retrieval benchmarks.
3) Week 3: expand to simulated production load; if PHI concerns persist, we switch to a short-lived VPC trial for subset.

Environment options and recommended default
- Hosted (fastest): Redwood-managed, quickest to start, recommended for first two weeks to prove model/quality and measure baseline cost/latency.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU): good if you need predictable concurrency and want to run longer multi-day load tests.
- VPC/private trial: for PHI/data residency — supports customer-managed networking, KMS, and audit logs; setup takes longer (network + security review).

Our recommendation: start hosted for rapid validation, then pivot to a scoped VPC sandbox only for the PHI subset if required. That minimizes upfront ops while preserving a path to a compliant environment.

Attachments: medsync-eval-template.xlsx (evaluation matrices), redwood-env-comparison.pdf (short comparison).

Next steps / owners
- Emma / MedSync: confirm the eval dataset slice and whether the PHI subset requires VPC by EOD Thu (2026-09-04).
- Aditya (technical): will draft network checklist and preflight items for either hosted or VPC kickoff.
- Irene (sales/ops): schedule a 45-min kickoff once dataset confirmation is in; align success metrics and formal timeline.

Proposed kickoff windows: Tue 2026-09-07 or Thu 2026-09-09 (09:30–11:00 PT). Let me know what works and which environment you want to default to.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

—
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@medsynchealth.com>

Subject: Re: MedSync Health — trial scope & environment decision

Hi Irene — thanks for the clear write-up. A few clarifying notes from our side: 

1) PHI & compliance: We do process PHI for a small percentage of records. Our security team will likely require VPC + customer-managed KMS for any trial containing raw PHI. Can you outline the minimum steps to get a scoped VPC trial spun up?

2) Timeline: We prefer a quick proof-of-concept this month. If VPC is mandatory for PHI, can you share a conservative setup duration? We could run a hosted trial against de-identified data immediately.

3) Evaluation success: The team is comfortable with the 90% precision target for extraction; for latency, can you confirm whether the 200ms target is achievable under hosted baseline or if that requires dedicated GPUs?

We can confirm the eval slice by EOD Thursday — I will loop in our CTO, Carlos, if needed. Also, can you share any sample network requirements so our infra team can pre-approve ports/IP ranges?

Best,
Emma
Emma Jenkins
Dir. Data & Analytics | MedSync Health

Hi all — quick technical note and a compact preflight checklist to accelerate whichever path you pick. I built this assuming we start with hosted + optional VPC for PHI. Attachment: network-checklist.txt (stub).

Hosted baseline (what we provision immediately)
- API keys scoped to trial project; no customer-managed KMS for hosted.
- Data ingestion: HTTPS endpoints + S3-compatible upload (we can ingest a ZIP of de-id docs).
- Telemetry & logs: tokenized traces; we can enable stricter redaction for submitted text.

VPC setup (if PHI required) — rough timeline: 7–12 business days from signed connectivity form + infra contact
- Customer provides CIDR, public egress IP block for firewall rules, and KMS key ARN (if using AWS KMS).
- We schedule a short network review call and perform a health check on the customer peering/VPN.
- Once approved, we deploy a scoped VPC trial stack and issue VPC-restricted API keys.

Network checklist (high level)
- Outbound allowed: 13.32.0.0/16 (Redwood egress) & redwood-managed URL list.
- TLS mutual auth optional for VPC; if required, provide cert contact.
- Test endpoint: we’ll provide a temporary test URL for connectivity checks.

Latency note: Achieving p50 <=200ms is realistic on hosted for small-to-moderate prompt sizes (<=256 tokens) using an optimized model variant; sustained <=200ms at high QPS may need a dedicated sandbox or tuned batching profile. We can include a single-day dedicated burst if you want to validate concurrency.

Action items I’ll own:
- Share the full network-checklist.txt and a sample connectivity form by EOD Monday (2026-09-07).
- Stand up a hosted eval environment within 24–48 hours of dataset handoff.

—
Aditya Rao
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Emma — great questions and thanks Aditya for the details. Quick decision path and proposed plan so we can lock calendar: 

Decision path
- If MedSync can supply a de-identified slice by Thu (2026-09-10), we will:
  * Immediately spin hosted trial and run the quality+latency benchmarks (targeting 48–72 hours to first results).
  * If precision or latency needs further stress tests, we run a 24–48 hour dedicated burst next week.
- If MedSync requires raw PHI in the trial:
  * We start the VPC scoping in parallel but treat the VPC trial as the compliance path (7–12 business days setup).

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-09-14 at 10:00 AM PT — 45 minutes. Objective: dataset handoff, success-metric alignment, and immediate host trial plan. I’m booking tentatively; please confirm or suggest an alternate.

Owners & immediate asks
- MedSync (Emma): confirm which data slice is de-identified vs PHI and share sample files by Thu 2026-09-10 EOD.
- Aditya: share network-checklist.txt and the connectivity form (owner: aditya.rao@redwood.ai).
- Grace: I’ll loop you in for billing/commit questions if we pivot to dedicated capacity.

If we don’t hear back by EOD Thu we’ll proceed with the hosted path against de-id data and hold VPC scoping until you confirm PHI needs.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for 9/14 and attach the two docs (eval template + env comparison) again.

—
